message:
In the tilted roof Photovoltaic array (Photovoltaic (PV), sunlight-to-electricity panels) (C2), Maya, the cloudy-refill sizing method has missing low-sun balance problem. To check it I used standard off-grid review of the Photovoltaic array sizing calculation (E14). I found 1600 watts minimum for fair sun only with no 2-day cloudy refill, according to DIY Eco Homes, 2024. I propose you compute low-sun daily balance before freezing size. My position: not ready because Function 3 for night and cloudy ride-through cannot close otherwise.

In the Direct Current vapour-compression cold room (Direct Current (DC), battery-driven cooling) (C1), Sam, the door-opening air exchange has uncounted energy problem. To check it I used interface review of the door conduction estimate (E10) against the combined thermal load (E9). I found 13.8 watts conduction only with no infiltration Kilowatt-hour added (Kilowatt-hour (kWh), energy unit), according to Council Whiteboard, 2026. I propose you add daily door-opening Kilowatt-hours to steady load. My position: not ready because steady load underpins autonomy.

In the 48-volt Lithium Iron Phosphate battery bank (Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4), long-life lithium chemistry) (C3), Sam, the 1.5-day autonomy proof has pending sign-off problem. To check it I used whiteboard read-across of the autonomy sizing calculation (E13). I found 11.25 Kilowatt-hours nominal at 80 percent usable fraction, according to Azzouz and co-workers, 2020. I propose closing the prior autonomy objection once infiltration is added. My position: not ready because two new energy gaps block vote.
Note on Solar Power Specialist: staged sizing advanced, cloudy balance requested.
Note on Refrigeration and Thermal Engineer: compressor duty stated, infiltration add requested.
Note on Structural Enclosure Designer: door conduction closed, air-leakage energy waiting.
Note on Post-Harvest Cooperative Operations Lead: staged intake ready, power closure pending.
